summary_en: RISE Inc. received a conversion request from its parent company JTM Holdings to convert all 6,244,307 A-series preferred shares into ordinary shares at a 1:1 ratio. The company subsequently resolved to cancel these 6,244,307 preferred shares acquired through conversion. After cancellation, total issued shares are 102,257,584 ordinary shares. All conversions and cancellation are effective October 28, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acceptance of Conversion Request of Preferred Shares into Ordinary Shares and Cancellation of Treasury Stock (Preferred Shares)
translation_en_brief:
RISE Inc. announced on October 28, 2026 that it accepted a conversion request from its parent company JTM Holdings Co., Ltd. to convert all A-series preferred shares into ordinary shares. Under the company's articles of incorporation, JTM Holdings, which holds 53.99% of voting rights in RISE Inc., requested the conversion of 6,244,307 preferred shares into ordinary shares on a 1:1 basis.

Following the conversion, the company's board of directors on the same date resolved to cancel all 6,244,307 preferred shares acquired through this conversion, pursuant to the Companies Act. This action consolidates the company's capital structure by eliminating the preferred share class.

After completion of both the conversion and cancellation effective October 28, 2026, RISE Inc.'s total issued shares consist solely of 102,257,584 ordinary shares, with no preferred shares outstanding.
